name: Burglar’s Lock and Key
body:
Aura faint transmutation; CL 1st; Slot —; Price 1,000 gp; Weight 1 lb.

DESCRIPTION

This heavy iron lock bears a stout, pitted key permanently fixed in the keyhole. Using a standard action to twist the key counterclockwise, you instantly open one door, chest, bag, bottle, or container within 30 ft. (Note, this does not unlock them.) Cautious rogues and lazy nobles frequently make use of this device.

Any container or portal weighing more than 30 lb. or restrained in any way (latched, bolted, tied) automatically resists this effect.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item, Spells open/close; Cost 500 gp
